participation.context: Asked, and did not take her letter in his hand.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the bag, the twopence already paid, and the stair.
participation.name: Thomas Hobbins

participation.context: Had been at the Bell and had gone back to St Bride's. He did not speak.
participation.name: Gilbert Shakespeare

story.body: You confirmed the letter of the 26th was in the bag. You did not pay the twopence again. You left Anne's letter for the stair.

title: Confirmed the 26th in the bag and Anne's letter on the stair

participation.context: Read the letter and did not answer it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Had written the decision. She was not in the room.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

story.body: You read that the wash was already set and already paid. You wrote nothing back.

title: Read that the wash was already paid

participation.context: Said it, and did not go to the pen.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You named the fact of being told, named the fourpence, and stopped without a reply.

title: Said Anne had set the wash, and named the fourpence
